text:
85. One respondent suggested that there should be further explanatory material which
sets out the way in which prison sentences operate, with specific reference to how
the release of short- and long-term prisoners works in practice. While the Council
appreciates that these issues will be of importance to those involved in a case,
whether as victims or as offenders, they do not relate to the sentencing process
and therefore do not belong in this guideline. Information about these matters can
be found on the Council’s website and elsewhere.
The impact of the guideline

86. Questions 19, 20, 21, and 22 are about the impact the guideline will have if it
comes into force.
